name: cpig-73-voronoi-foam
description: 73 Voronoi Foam Field (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Stochastic)

setup.vlmDescription: NOT YET VERIFIED — render was blank on first bring-up. When fixed: a light-blue cellular foam structure with thin walls between cell regions.
setup.whatItDoes: Implicit Voronoi foam from seed points. (d2 - d1) - wallThickness/2. F<=0 marks the wall network between cells (open-cell foam).
setup.whatYouShouldSee: NOTE: first bring-up render was BLANK — GH component showed red. When working: a light-blue mesh of thin walls between cellular regions around each seed.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
